questions.question: Dr Chiba, now a reference in team management, is invited to a congress. What message should he convey about the role of assistants?
options: The assistant is a secondary employee
The assistant is a strategic pillar of the modern practice
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'The assistant is a strategic pillar of the modern practice, contributing to the quality of care and patient satisfaction.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must create a quality charter for assistants. Which pillars should be included?
options: Quality of care, safety and patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The quality charter must be based on quality of care, safety and patient relationship.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must train young dentists in managing assistants. What is the key message?
options: Assistants are employees like any other
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Assistants are care partners. Considering them as such is essential.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must create a mentoring program for assistants. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Mentoring allows transmitting practice values and training the new generation.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must evaluate the impact of assistants on practice performance. Which indicator is most relevant?
options: Patient satisfaction and quality of care
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Patient satisfaction and quality of care are the most relevant indicators.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must create a reward system for assistants. What is the best approach?
options: Regular recognition and career development prospects
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Regular recognition and career development prospects are the most sustainable motivation levers.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must train assistants in conflict management. What is the key message?
options: Communication is the key to conflict resolution
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Communication is the key to conflict resolution.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must create a good practice guide for assistants. What is the basis of the guide?
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Good practices must be based on professional recommendations.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a crisis situation with an assistant. What is the right approach?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Open dialogue and solution-finding allow effective crisis management.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate his assistant's communication skills. What is the key skill?
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Active listening and empathy are the key skills for effective communication.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must create a well-being program for assistants. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'A well-being program improves assistants' health and motivation.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage a conflict of interest with his assistant. What is the right attitude?
options: Declare the conflict and act transparently
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Transparency is the only acceptable attitude in the face of a conflict of interest.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must create an assistant evaluation system. Which criteria should be included?
options: Technical skills, relational skills and ethics
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The evaluation system must include technical skills, relational skills and ethics.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must train assistants in managing vulnerable patients. What is the key skill?
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Empathy and adaptability are the key skills for managing vulnerable patients.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a collective stress situation in the team. What is the right approach?
options: Organize relaxation moments and team bonding
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Relaxation moments and team bonding strengthen resilience to stress.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must create a recognition program for assistants. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Recognition motivates and retains assistants, which benefits the entire practice.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must evaluate the quality of the relationship between his assistants and patients. Which method is most reliable?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Direct observation and patient feedback are the most reliable methods.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must train assistants in complaint management. What is the key skill?
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Active listening and problem-solving are the key skills for managing complaints.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must create a career plan for his assistants. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'A career plan helps develop assistants' skills and strengthen their motivation.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage a harassment situation in the team. What is the priority?
options: Protect the victim and sanction the harasser
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Protecting the victim and sanctioning the harasser are legal and moral obligations.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must create a code of ethics for assistants. Which pillars should be included?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The code of ethics must be based on ethics, confidentiality and patient respect.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must train assistants in emergency situation management. What is the key skill?
options: Ability to remain calm and follow protocols
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'The ability to remain calm and follow protocols is the key skill for managing emergencies.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must evaluate his assistants' performance. What criteria should be considered?
options: Technical skills, relational skills and ethics
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The evaluation must take into account technical skills, relational skills and ethics.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage a conflict between his assistant and a patient. What is the right approach?
options: Facilitate mediation and find an agreement
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Mediation allows finding an acceptable solution for both parties.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba and Dr Zaki, after training an exceptional team, receive a tribute. What message do they leave for young practitioners?
options: The assistant is an indispensable pillar of the practice
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba and Dr Zaki conclude: 'The assistant is an indispensable pillar of the practice, on par with the dentist.'
